versions.content: If UdpNm_SoAdIfTriggerTransmit is called a nd UdpNmComUserDataSupport is enabled, UdpNm shall collect the NM User Data from the referenced NM I - PDU by calling PduR_UdpNmTriggerTransmit and copy the data to the user data range of the NM - PDU.
